evidence.decision: Separates timely event content, private previews, useful immediate actions, foreground updates and unread-notification badge truth.
evidence.artifact: Delivers preview-hidden text, actions/deep links, foreground behavior and badge lifecycle with corrected category or handling logic.
evidence.transformation: Banking example removes exposed balance, balance-valued badge and redundant Open App action in favor of safe contextual notification behavior.
evidence.verification: Checks locked previews, duplicate events, resolved actions, unread counts and Watch fallback; disclosure, wrong object or unrelated badges fail.
evidence.applicability: Qualifies Watch short/long looks, static fallback, nondestructive double tap and absence of programmable custom vibration; delivery requires runtime proof.
evidence.handoffs: Managing notifications handles consent/urgency and Alerts handles immediate error resolution rather than overloading notification copy.
evidence.distinctiveness: Preview redaction, action outcomes and Notification Center badge lifecycle distinguish this from generic feedback.
